subject: SIG: Consolidated encryption artifacts, rotation timeline, and HSM attestations
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena@bluecrest.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG: initial list of artifacts we need for encryption section

Hi Marcus and Irene,

Thanks again for taking our SIG follow-up call yesterday. As we start compiling artifacts for our security review team, could you provide a consolidated package that covers the following areas for Redwood-managed tenants: 

- KMS key inventory (key IDs, creation dates, algorithm, owner/team)
- HSM attestation(s) or vendor tamper/evidence reports for the last 12 months
- Key rotation schedule and a sample rotation runbook (operator steps and rollback)
- Controls summary showing where keys are in transit vs at-rest and what wraps/KEK are used
- Any CCRs/log excerpts proving key eviction/eviction tests (redact PII)

We'd like a versioned package and a short timeline for delivery (ideally within 2 weeks). Please include suggested redaction guidance for any operator usernames if needed.

Attachments: none in this thread from us.

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Security Program Manager
BlueCrest Capital
[elena@bluecrest.com]

--
Elena Cruz
BlueCrest Capital

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Cruz <elena@bluecrest.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-12T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: initial list of artifacts we need for encryption section

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. We can assemble a consolidated ZIP containing: an exported KMS inventory CSV, the HSM vendor attestation PDF, a redacted sample of operator rotation logs, and a rotation_runbook_v1 (spreadsheet + markdown). Preliminary commitments below:

- Inventory CSV (redwood_kms_snapshot_20250410.csv): delivery by 2025-04-16 EOD
- HSM attestation (hsm_attestation_may2024.pdf): included (we'll annotate scope and CA chain)
- Rotation schedule & runbook (rotation_schedule_v1.xlsx + rotation_runbook.md): delivery by 2025-04-16 EOD
- CCR/log excerpts: redacted examples by 2025-04-18; full raw logs would require an approved NDAs/transfer process

Notes/asks from our side:
1) For the CCR/log excerpts you want an SFTP or secure SharePoint link? We can deliver via a one-time signed link with 14-day expiry.
2) Please confirm whether BlueCrest prefers operator IDs anonymized (e.g., op-001) or fully redacted. We will provide a mapping key under a separate, encrypted channel if requested.
3) For SIG checklist reference, is there a particular CAIQ item you want us to prioritize? We can surface the mapping doc as part of the package.

I'm looping in Irene (controls) and Marissa (security eng) who will own assembling the artifacts.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Product Manager, Security
Redwood Inference
[marcus@redwood.com]

Attachments: hsm_attestation_may2024.pdf (will attach in the consolidated package)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Cruz <elena@bluecrest.com>
Date: 2025-04-14T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: initial list of artifacts we need for encryption section

Marcus / Marissa —

Working plan below (internal owners and minimal contents):

1) KMS inventory (owner: Irene Choi)
   - redwood_kms_snapshot_20250410.csv: key_id, version, created_at, algorithm, usage (transit/at-rest), region, tenant_tag
   - Produce a short mapping doc that explains tenant tagging and key scoping

2) HSM attestations & vendor evidence (owner: Marissa Cole)
   - hsm_attestation_may2024.pdf (vendor-signed) + attestation metadata (firmware versions, signing CA)
   - Include statement about tamper event reporting cadence and escrow process

3) Rotation runbook & schedule (owner: Irene Choi + Marissa)
   - rotation_schedule_v1.xlsx with planned quarterly cadence for KEKs, monthly for CEKs by default
   - rotation_runbook.md: operator steps, acceptance tests, rollback, and quick-eviction checklist

4) Logs/CCR excerpts (owner: Marissa Cole)
   - Provide 3 redacted samples showing a rotation event, a forced eviction, and a successful wrap/unwrap test
   - Deliver via one-time signed S3 link; include checksum file

5) Delivery & gating
   - We will prepare a single ZIP (redwood_encryption_package_BC-4529_v1.zip) and a manifest file listing checksums and a short README on redaction decisions
   - Proposed delivery: artifacts 2025-04-16 (inventory + attestation + schedule), logs 2025-04-18 (redacted samples)

Elena — we will attach the HSM attestation PDF to the ZIP. For operator ID handling, recommend we send an anonymized mapping (op-001 -> hashed id) under a separate encrypted message; approve?

Marissa — can you confirm the exact firmware build and whether the vendor report includes signed PCR values? If not, note that in the manifest so the reviewer doesn't expect raw PCR snapshots.

Irene
Director, Security Controls
Redwood Inference

Attachments (to be included in final ZIP): redwood_kms_snapshot_20250410.csv, hsm_attestation_may2024.pdf, rotation_schedule_v1.xlsx, rotation_runbook.md, ccr_samples_redacted.tar.gz

From: Elena Cruz <elena@bluecrest.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, security@bluecrest.com
Date: 2025-04-18T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: initial list of artifacts we need for encryption section

Thanks Marcus and team — this plan looks good and the timeline works for our internal reviewers. Two quick clarifications before you package: 

1) For the KMS inventory CSV, please include a column that indicates whether a key is customer-managed (BYOK) vs. Redwood-managed.
2) For redaction mapping: we prefer anonymized IDs (op-001) plus a separate encrypted mapping file delivered to our security mailbox.

Once we receive the ZIP, we'll confirm receipt and schedule a short walkthrough (30 minutes) to review the runbook acceptance tests. After that, we may ask for a signed attestation letter (signature by an authorized vendor contact) as a final step for our compliance file.

If you can attach the initial ZIP to a secure Drive link and paste it into HubSpot under Deal BC-4529 that will help our tracking.

Elena
Security Program Manager
BlueCrest Capital

[attachment stub: redwood_encryption_package_BC-4529_v1.zip (contains listed artifacts) | checksum: sha256:abcd1234... ]
